About this website

Site privacy.

Updated October 23, 2026. This notice covers the public Fuego marketing website at fuego.ailuxis.com. It does not describe data handling inside the Fuego application, connected AI services, or NeroNook.

A small, static website.

This website does not include a signup form, user accounts, advertising trackers, custom analytics, or third-party font requests. Its interactive examples run in your browser using sample content. They do not connect to AI providers, access your files, or execute tasks.

Hosting and request data.

The site is hosted on Vercel, with DNS managed through Cloudflare. Serving a web request can involve processing technical information such as IP address, requested URL, browser information, and timestamps for delivery, reliability, and abuse prevention. For information about the providers’ own practices, see Vercel’s privacy policy and Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

Links to other sites.

Links to NeroNook, Ailuxis, and hosting-provider policies take you to separate websites with their own practices. No Fuego account information is included in these links.

Browser storage.

The site’s own code does not set cookies or save visitor data in browser storage. Selecting a demo step or opening a question only changes the current page. Pointer and scroll positions are used temporarily in your browser to render the interactive background; the site does not store or transmit them.
